rachel: Heads-up: the quokka-int8 onboard canary is showing sporadic structured output failures in our funcall harness. ~9/1000 invocations flagged as 'root not object / missing actions'. Most payloads look like an array or end with EOF inside the object. Anyone seen this with kvcache+multibatch? :confused:

matt: Can you paste one raw capture (sanitized) so we can see whether it's truncated vs wrong root shape?

rachel: Pasted sanitized examples from the capture: 
```json
// example A - top-level array
[ { "tool": "create_task", "params": { "title": "Deploy" } } ]

// example B - truncated EOF
{"actions": [{"tool":"assign","params":{"to":"infra"}} ,
```

sylvie: Noting correlation: failures spike when batch>=6 and kvpolicy=prefix. fp16 baseline had near-zero. Also most fails have sequence length > 450 and coincide with kernel picks 'fast-attn-v3' in the log.

ci-bot: canary 2026-06-02T08:00:00Z started (job cj-2001): model=quokka-int8, nodes=2, batch=8. Capturing raw_tokens + assembler_trace. Logs: https://ci.internal/canary/cj-2001 :rocket:

bench-bot: quick replay summary (n=4000): kvprefix=on => 9.1/1000 parse_fail; kvprefix=off => 0.7/1000. 68% of fails end exactly at assembler refill boundary. Anchoring prompt with explicit terminator <ACTIONS_END> reduces to 0.3/1000.

matt: That strongly suggests a streaming assembler boundary trim. Two immediate actions: 1) add a runtime sentinel injection (append terminator if not present) in retriever as hotfix, 2) add a postprocess safe-wrap that converts top-level arrays into {"actions": <array>} and treats it as a retryable event (max 2 retries). I'll sketch a minimal PR to recompute total length after joining chunks and assert final byte is a JSON terminator in stream_assembler.cc.

sylvie: I'll run narrow canaries: kvprefix disabled + sentinel injection + postproc-lint to measure. If assembler patch lands we'll re-enable kvprefix behind a canary toggle. Also open a kernel-correlation ticket in infra (linking assembler_trace + kernel logs).

rachel: Implemented postproc-lint+wrap on the canary branch and bumped retry policy to linear-2. Running replay + seed set now. Will post results shortly. TY :thumbsup:
